# Oliver Charles Garden Design & Build

Oliver Charles Garden Design & Build is a family-run garden design and build company based in Amersham, Buckinghamshire, serving the Chilterns and surrounding Home Counties (HP5–HP16), including Amersham, Chesham, Beaconsfield, Chalfont St Giles, Little Chalfont, Great Missenden, Chorleywood, and High Wycombe.

The company specialises in high-end hard landscaping and complete garden construction: porcelain patios, composite decking, glass balustrades, and full garden landscaping. Every project is design-and-build, handled in-house from initial consultation through to completion, with a 5-year workmanship guarantee.

- Phone: +44 7837 666766
- Email: info@ocgardendesign.co.uk
- Hours: Monday–Friday 8:00–18:00, Saturday 9:00–14:00, Sunday closed
